title: Luke Patrols
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Luke Patrols the icy wastelands of Hoth on his trusty tauntaun (front), searching for signs of unwelcome Imperial visitors in this 1980 sketch by Joe Jusko, then cover artist for THE HULK. Darth Vader and Luke Skywalker fight their climactic battle on this striking cover (back) of Marvel's conclusion to its adaptation of THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK.
